Reasoning: Since PRSV is a rectangle, the top side VS and the bottom side PR are equal in length, VS=20 cm; the height of the rectangle is PV=12 cm. method.method_draft: Direct shaded-region decomposition: First read the diagram as a rectangle PRSV with V,U,T,S in order along the top edge and P,Q,R along the bottom edge. The shaded parts are exactly three triangles: triangle VPU, triangle UQT, and triangle TSR. From the text, use PR=20 cm and PV=12 cm; since PRSV is a rectangle, the top side VS also has length 20 cm and the vertical distance between VS and PR is 12 cm. Each shaded triangle has its base on the top side VS and its opposite vertex on the bottom side PR, so each has height 12 cm. Add their areas as one combined expression: shaded area = (1/2)(VU+UT+TS)(12). Because VU+UT+TS=VS=20, the shaded area is (1/2)(20)(12)=120 cm^2.
